label: No body can be the instrument…, from The designated human intellectual principle… and 2 more
description: A typed reductio derives no bodily organ of intellectual exercise from three explicit open premises, reusing the existing cognitive-capacity and bodily-determinacy definitions. Comparator checks three omission controls as well; the last shows why the prior non-bodyhood result and its interference premise do not suffice for organ independence. These are finite schema models, not physicalist implementations or possible-world claims. Object-side bodily dependence, per-se subsistence, immortality and the assessment of whole physicalist rivals remain outside this result. No root premise is discharged.
